propositions: AGENTS.md currently claims symbol tools are universally preferable to grep for finding references, but this is false when symbols are referenced via string literals (e.g., monkeypatch.setattr) which LSP cannot resolve
LSP index can lag behind recent edits in the working tree, causing it to report stale line numbers inconsistent with current source
A rule that is conditionally true trains agents to discount it entirely, contributing to missed sites and failures in dependent stories

The division of labour between LSP (semantic symbol resolution), grep (string-literal references, working-tree freshness), and direct code search must be explicitly encoded in AGENTS.md as a decision table
Documentation must be updated to name the string-literal blind spot with concrete examples (monkeypatch.setattr) and caveat the LSP index staleness
